harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.versionRecording: operator supplies --codex-version or PI_NEXT_CODEX_CLI_VERSION in credentialed reports

integrationRuntimeComplexity.runtimeDependency: external Codex CLI on PATH or --codex-command; no npm dependency added
integrationRuntimeComplexity.credentialPath: Codex CLI/provider credentials managed outside pi-next; GitHub/Git authority is scrubbed from worker environment
integrationRuntimeComplexity.operationalFriction: lower than embedding mini-SWE Python harness; higher than built-in Pi because operators must install and version-record the CLI

coverage: WorkerAdapter invocation on the same independently graded canary seam
no lifecycle authority APIs in the adapter

challengers.credentialedCorpusStatus: not checked in by this change; do not promote without a real report on the identical six-fixture corpus
metricsRequiredForPromotion: tokens and cost per verified completion

selectionRationale: Pi remains selectable and default because the only committed full-corpus credentialed evidence is the Pi baseline. Codex CLI is available for apples-to-apples credentialed comparison but is not promoted without material verified-completion-per-cost/reliability evidence.
